hookups.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/silver-lake-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120180 ('There are 23 sites (#1-23) at Silver Lake Campground with water and electric with 30 and 50 amp hookup.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All 23 sites are 'RV or Tent' with equipment lengths 30-50 ft; sites 1, 2, 7 and 19 are pull-throughs (40-50 ft). Maximum 1 RV and 1 tent, or 2 tents, per site. Sites 19-21 have enhanced accessibility.

sites.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/silver-lake-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120180 (site list: Equip length/Driveway '40 Pull-Through', '45 Pull-Through', '50 Pull-Through', '50 Back-In' ...; 'Maximum of 1 RV and 1 tent or 2 tents per site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: A bathhouse; picnic table and fire ring with grate and/or grill at each site. Day-use area next door with a boat ramp and rentable pavilion.

facilities.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/silver-lake-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120180 ('There is a bathhouse and a dump station.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance.' The Florida Forest Service closes every state forest campground when the county is under a tropical storm or hurricane warning, with automatic refunds.

summary: Confirmed 30/50-amp electric + water at all 23 sites, $22.42 fee unchanged; added sites (23, to 50 ft, 4 pull-throughs), dump station, year-round season, ReserveAmerica 11-month window incl. same day. No storm closure posted (FDACS notice is only the River Junction boat ramp). AWH note kept as is.
flags: Missing phone: the booking page and FDACS list (352) 797-4140 for Withlacoochee State Forest / Silver Lake Campground.
Missing agency website: the entry has only the ReserveAmerica link; FDACS's forest page is https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Withlacoochee-State-Forest.

Waterfront lead (entry: lakeview): the booking page says the campground is 'On the shore of Silver Lake, which is part of the Withlacoochee River system'. AWH's note ('Some campsites are very close to the lake and appear to have a partial lake view') is firsthand and supports lakeview; only a re-audit could change it.
